Her facial expression is one of distress, with her mouth downturned as if about to cry. To her left is a yellow shopping bag, and behind her are rolled-up papers and storage items in a brightly lit indoor home setting. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a clear plastic storage bin on a wooden shelf, overflowing with various plush toys, including a giraffe and a duck. (3) Returning to the original scene, the child stands up from the wicker basket, looking toward the right. The lighting is natural and even throughout the room. (4) The camera follows the child from a high angle as she walks from the corner, through a doorway, and into an adjacent living area. An adult's legs in black shorts and socks are briefly visible. (5) The child approaches a play area with a colorful tent and a bin of balls. She spots a large, white, rounded plush toy resembling an oyster on the floor and bends down to pick it up with both hands, looking relieved. (6) The child stands proudly holding the large plush toy against her chest. She then puts her hands together in a clapping or celebratory gesture. A second child wearing a mask is partially visible in the background, sitting near a table.
